name: Chadickith
inventory: Explorer's pack (backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, waterskin, 50 ft hempen rope)
A small ember-black stone from Okton's forge (keepsake)
Silver key token on a cord (Ember Keep gate-sergeant, dawn bell)
Grey burial-notice note from a Pyrewarden (Ashward almshouse, tomorrow's dusk bell)
features: Unarmored Defense (not used: Natural Armor is higher)
Storm Aura: Desert (10 ft; 2 fire to ALL other creatures in aura incl. allies; on entering rage and as a bonus action; no save)
Trunk (5 ft reach; grapple/lift/unarmed strike; can't wield weapons)
Strike of the Giants: Fire (+1d10 fire once per turn on melee or thrown weapon hit; PB uses/long rest)
notes: Age 76 (young for a loxodon). Egotistical know-it-all who gets humbled often. Born in Hadrun (Cinder Hills) to Berov and Radanya, who died when a blood-raged roc destroyed the village in 1423 DR, when he was 8. Raised for 68 years by Okton, a fire giant smith of Kharun, who calls him 'Small Tusk'. Member of Okton's Order of the Banked Fire but has NOT undergone the blood ritual (the Quenching). 7 ft, 318 lb, tortoiseshell coat of lion-tan and bistre fur. AC 15 = Natural Armor (12 + CON).
